description: Public TikTok profile from the profile page's embedded data: user ID, secUid, nickname, bio, bio link, verified, private and organization flags, language, avatar, creation date, and exact counts of followers, following, likes, videos and friends. The page carries no video list for anonymous visitors, so videos are not included. Unknown usernames return 404. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_tiktok_comments when you need Top-level comments of a public TikTok video from TikTok's; social_tiktok_hashtag_analytics when you need TikTok hashtag stats from TikTok's public hashtag detail. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

username.description: TikTok username (with or without @), or a tiktok.com/@user URL
